props.text: Tired of Claude Code {a:interrupting every step?}

props.title: Claude Code (default)
lines: > Update the navigation bar across all 12 pages
Claude: Found 12 files. Should I update index first or all of them?
> All of them. Please don't ask every step!
Claude: Updated 3 files. But what about the submenu? How should I proceed?
{a:! You say "do it autonomously", yet it halts to ask every few minutes}

props.title: Claude Code [AUTO]
lines: > /work-mode auto
> Update the navigation bar across all 12 pages
[auto] All 12 pages updated, submenus adapted automatically.
[auto] Tests passed. Reversible local steps done without chit-chat!
{a:Work flows freely! Only real risks (payments, deletes) ask}

props.text: out mode: {a:delegate batch tasks & save quota}

props.title: Claude Code [OUT]
lines: > /work-mode out
> Classify and summarize these 1,000 user feedback items
[out] Heavy batch detected: delegated to background workers
Main thread only verifies results, saving 20%+ weekly Claude quota!
{a:No more grinding batch tasks in the main chat or draining quota}

props.text: Trying to wrap up? {a:AI opens endless new tangents}

props.title: Claude Code (default)
lines: > Ready to wrap up, status report please
Claude: Updated 12 pages. By the way, test coverage is low...
Claude: Should we refactor the CSS too? Plus 3 suggestions...
> I just need to know what decisions require my sign-off!
{a:! It tangents into new topics, burying the decisions you need to make}

props.text: wrap mode: {a:stop tangents and converge on decisions}

props.title: Claude Code [WRAP]
lines: > /work-mode wrap
> Ready to wrap up, status report
[wrap] Active tasks converged. No new tangents or random proposals.
{a:【Decisions Needed】}
1. [Outbound] Send project report? -> Rec: Yes, draft ready
2. [Payment] Confirm plan upgrade?  -> Rec: Plan A
{a:Only what you must decide, so you can finish work in peace}

props.text: One command to {a:shape AI to your working tempo}

props.title: Claude Code
lines: > /work-mode auto out wrap
[Modes Active: AUTO + OUT + WRAP]
auto -> Zero conversational interruptions on local work
out  -> Offload batch jobs to background subagents
wrap -> Stop tangents, strictly converge on decisions

props.text: Control AI autonomy, delegation, and focus with one simple slash command
